articles.title: Prudential (NYSE:PRU) Reports Q4 CY2025 In Line With Expectations
articles.mainIdea: Prudential (NYSE:PRU) Reports Q4 CY2025 In Line With Expectations
articles.summary: StockStory: Prudential (NYSE:PRU) Reports Q4 CY2025 In Line With Expectations. Financial services giant Prudential Financial (NYSE:PRU) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 11.6% year on year to $14.52 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.30 per share was 1.9% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

articles.summary: Associated Press Finance: Prudential: Q4 Earnings Snapshot. NEWARK, N.J. (AP) — Prudential Financial Inc. PRU) on Tuesday reported fourth-quarter profit of $905 million. On a per-share basis, the Newark, New Jersey-based company said it had net income of $2.55.
